raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

- enable CUDA 13.4's native SM107 target for Vera Rubin
- allow SM107 to reuse compatible SM100-family kernels across the CUDA, DeepGEMM, FlashMLA, and QuTLASS builds
- resolve exact architecture matches before family fallbacks, preventing `10.0f` from masking `10.7f`

This follows [PyTorch #190654](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/190654). I also checked its review feedback and mirrored the corrected boundaries here: CUDA 13.4 is included with `VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL`, and SM107 handling does not overwrite other architecture selections.

For interim validation, PyTorch CI produced `torch-2.14.0a0+git90e4943` from the PR head, and that branch pins Triton commit `4774139fe59ed0a3adbdd8590a41f5295ad7d5eb`, available from the official PyTorch nightly index as `triton==3.8.0+git4774139f`. This PR does not permanently pin the CI wheel because the artifact is expiring and CPython 3.10-only; using the PyTorch Git branch directly would require building PyTorch from source.

## Duplicate-work check

No overlapping open vLLM PR was found when searching for `sm107`, `sm_107`, `Vera Rubin`, `Rubin`, or PyTorch PR `190654`.

## Testing

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_cmake_utils.py -v` — 1 passed
- manual CMake architecture-selection matrix covering exact SM107 selection, combined SM100/SM107 selection, and family fallback — passed
- `pre-commit run --files CMakeLists.txt cmake/utils.cmake cmake/external_projects/flashmla.cmake cmake/external_projects/deepgemm.cmake cmake/external_projects/qutlass.cmake tests/test_cmake_utils.py` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

Model evaluation is not applicable because this only changes build target selection and does not affect model output.

AI assistance (OpenAI Codex) was used to research, implement, and test this change. Human review of every changed line is required before marking this draft ready for review.

+
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def test_exact_family_arch_precedes_generic_family_fallback(tmp_path: Path):
+    repo_root = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+    script = tmp_path / "test_cuda_archs.cmake"
+    script.write_text(
+        f"""
+cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
+include("{repo_root / "cmake" / "utils.cmake"}")
+cuda_archs_loose_intersection(

+if(NOT "${{actual}}" STREQUAL "10.7f")
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "Expected 10.7f, got '${{actual}}'")
+endif()
+"""
+    )
+
+    subprocess.run(["cmake", "-P", script], check=True)
